transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: We’re wasting time. I’m leading the pitch. I want Bennett on numbers, Priya on client research, and everyone else focused on execution. If you disagree, say so now—otherwise, that’s the plan.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: Can we just pause a second? I want to make sure everyone’s okay with this plan. If someone has a concern, better to say it now than let it fester.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Could we quickly clarify who's handling the data analysis? I just want to be sure we're not missing any gaps this time.

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: If I’m hearing everyone right, Natasha’s proposing to lead and has assigned some clear roles. Erik, you’re checking if anyone has concerns before we move. Lilian, you want to clarify who’s on data. Does anyone feel uneasy about what’s been suggested? If so, please just say. Otherwise, let’s confirm who’s doing what, so no one’s left wondering.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Just to check, if Bennett’s on numbers, who’s backing him up on the data side? Last time, we had some confusion and I want to be sure we’re covered.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Can I just check—who’s supporting Bennett on the data work? I want to be sure we’re covered this time, just in case something unexpected comes up.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Just to be sure—does everyone feel clear about their role? If anyone's not sure, maybe we should iron it out now. I'd rather we all know exactly what's expected.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: Just to clarify—am I supporting Bennett on the backend integration, or is someone else covering that? I want to make sure we’re not missing anything on the API side.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Could we maybe go through the assignments one more time, just so we're all clear? I just want to make sure no one's missing anything or feeling left out.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Just to be clear, is anyone officially backing Bennett up on the data? I don't want us scrambling if he gets pulled onto something else.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: Bennett owns the numbers. Amitesh, you’re his backup—full stop. If anything happens, Amitesh steps in. Priya, client research. If anyone’s unclear, speak now. Otherwise, move.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: All right, got it—I'll back Bennett up on the data side. No issues from me.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: All right, sounds settled. No issues from me.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: All right, sounds clear to me. I’m good with the assignments. Let’s get to it.

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: All right, I just want to make sure—if anyone’s still unsure or wants to flag anything before we dive in, now’s the time. Otherwise, let’s get moving. We can check in along the way if anything crops up.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: All right, I’m clear on my part and happy to help if anything comes up. Let’s get started.

transcript.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
transcript.text: Okay, let’s get started then. If anything crops up, just shout. I’ll be around if anyone wants to check something along the way.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: All right, that's settled. Everyone knows their part. If you hit a roadblock, come straight to me—no detours. Otherwise, get moving.
